{{Top|leg}}
A '''microscopic subdermal tracker''' was a miniaturized [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing device]] that could injected into an individual. [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] paid a fortune to have a target, the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Rivo Xarran]], tagged with one of the trackers on [[Inat Prime]], leading Fett to track him to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Vryssa garrison|garrison]] on [[Vryssa]].<ref name="ND">{{JournalCite|14|No Disintegrations, Please}}</ref>
